neckEase.name: Neck ease (%)
neckEase.help: Controls how large the neck hole is.

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: Controls how wide the garment will be around the chest.

waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls how wide the garment will be around the chest.

hipsEase.name: Hips ease (%)
hipsEase.help: Controls how wide the garment will be at the bottom hem. This option is only used if the straight sides option is disabled.

seatEase.name: Seat ease (%)
seatEase.help: Controls how wide the seat is.

upperLegEase.name: Upper leg ease (%)
upperLegEase.help: Controls how wide the garment will be around the upper legs.

legHemEase.name: Leg hem ease (%)
legHemEase.help: Controls how wide the bottom of the legs will be.

centerSeamEase.name: Center seam ease (%)
centerSeamEase.help: Controls how long the center seam will be, and thus how low the crotch fork of the garment will be.

outseamEase.name: Outseam ease (%)
outseamEase.help: Controls how far down the garment the waist, hips, seat, and upper leg points on the outseam will be.

armpitEase.name: Armpit ease (%)
armpitEase.help: Gives more room in the armpit by shifting the sleeve down the body.

neckBalance.name: Neck position (%)
neckBalance.help: Controls where the neck hole is placed on the garment.

crotchGussetWidth.name: Crotch gusset width (%)
crotchGussetWidth.help: Controls how wide the crotch gusset will be. Adjust so that the front and back pieces look smooth and clean around the crotch fork and upper legs. Deeper thighs and abdomens require a larger value, while wider ones require a smaller value.

sleeveEase.name: Sleeve ease (%)
sleeveEase.help: Affects how wide the sleeve is at the armhole on all garments, and has some affect on the width at the hem of short sleeved garments.

wristEase.name: Wrist ease (%)
wristEase.help: Affects how wide the end of the sleeve is on sleeves that extend past the biceps. The effect is greater on longer sleeves.

neckStyle.name: Neck style
neckStyle.help: Select whether you want to add a hood to the garment, or finish the neck with a neckband.

skirt.name: Skirt
skirt.help: Select whether or not you want to add a simple gathered skirt around the waist of the garment.

legLength.name: Leg length (%)
legLength.help: Controls how long the legs of the garment will be.

sleeveLength.name: Sleeve length (%)
sleeveLength.help: Controls how long the sleeves of the garment will be.

raglanScoopLength.name: Raglan scoop length (%)
raglanScoopLength.help: Controls how far out from the armhole the raglan seam starts to scoop.

raglanScoopMagnitude.name: Raglan scoop depth (%)
raglanScoopMagnitude.help: Controls how much extra material to place under the armpits.

legTaperPosition.name: Leg taper position (%)
legTaperPosition.help: Controls how the lower legs are laid out on the pattern.

skirtWidth.name: Skirt width (%)
skirtWidth.help: Controls the width of the skirt at the bottom, as a percentage of the waist measurement.

skirtLength.name: Skirt length (%)
skirtLength.help: Controls the length of the skirt, as a percentage of the waist to upper leg measurement.

skirtWaistband.name: Skirt waistband (%)
skirtWaistband.help: Sets the width of the waistband along the top of the skirt, as a multiple of the seam allowance.

skirtHem.name: Skirt hem (%)
skirtHem.help: Sets the hem allowance of the hem along the bottom of the skirt, as a multiple of the seam allowance.

sleeveRibbingWidth.name: Sleeve Ribbing Width (%)
sleeveRibbingWidth.help: Controls how wide the ribbing around the sleeve is.

sleeveRibbingLength.name: Sleeve Ribbing Length (%)
sleeveRibbingLength.help: Controls how long the ribbing around the sleeve is, as a percentage of the sleeve circumference.

legRibbingWidth.name: Leg Ribbing Width (%)
legRibbingWidth.help: Controls how wide the ribbing around the leg is.

legRibbingLength.name: Leg Ribbing Length (%)
legRibbingLength.help: Controls how long the ribbing around the leg is, as a percentage of the leg circumference.

hoodDepth.name: Hood depth (%)
hoodDepth.help: Controls how much room will be in the hood around the back of the head.

hoodHeight.name: Hood height (%)
hoodHeight.help: Controls how tall the hood will be.

hoodFrontDip.name: Hood Front dip (%)
hoodFrontDip.help: Controls far down the front of the hood drops over the forehead.

hoodHem.name: Hood hem (%)
hoodHem.help: Sets the hem allowance along the front of the hood, as a multiple of the seam allowance.

hoodFrontBonus.name: Hood front bonus (%)
hoodFrontBonus.help: Controls how far forward the hood comes over the forehead.

hoodFrontPieceSize.name: Hood front piece size (%)
hoodFrontPieceSize.help: Controls if a front piece will be used, and how wide the front piece of the hood will be.

sleeveRibbing.name: Sleeve Ribbing
sleeveRibbing.help: Choose whether to make ribbed knit cuffs for the sleeves or to use a hem.

legRibbing.name: Leg Ribbing
legRibbing.help: Choose whether to make ribbed knit cuffs for the legs or to use a hem.

zipperPosition.name: Zipper Position
zipperPosition.help: Select where to place the zipper.

legHem.name: Leg hem (%)
legHem.help: Sets the hem allowance of the hem along the bottom of the legs, as a multiple of the seam allowance.

frontOnFold.name: Front on fold
frontOnFold.help: Enable this option to make the front out of a single piece, or disable to make it out of two mirrored pieces joined by a seam. It is recommended to disable this if placing a front zipper, and enable it otherwise.

backOnFold.name: Back on fold
backOnFold.help: Enable this option to make the back out of a single piece, or disable to make it out of two mirrored pieces joined by a seam. It is recommended to disable this if placing a back zipper, and enable it otherwise.

zipperLength.name: Zipper length (%)
zipperLength.help: The length of the zipper, as a percentage of the vertical trunk. It is recommended that you match this length (shown below in cm/in) to the length of the actual zipper, measured from lower stop to upper stop.

neckbandLength.name: Neckband length (%)
neckbandLength.help: Controls how long the neckband is, as a percentage of the circumference of the neckline.

neckbandWidth.name: Neckband width (%)
neckbandWidth.help: Controls how wide the finished neckband will be.

zipperGuardWidth.name: Zipper guard width (%)
zipperGuardWidth.help: How wide to make the zipper guard.

neckGuardLength.name: Neck guard length (%)
neckGuardLength.help: How far to have the zipper guard extend past the top of the zipper.

sleeveHem.name: Sleeve hem (%)
sleeveHem.help: Sets the hem allowance of the hem along the end of the sleeves, as a multiple of the seam allowance.
